Then the LORD said to Moses,
And the Lord said to Moses,
耶和華曉諭摩西說：
“See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
I have made selection of Bezalel, the son of Uri, by name, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
「看哪，猶大支派中，戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列，我已經題他的名召他。
And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship,
And I have given him the spirit of God and made him wise and full of knowledge and expert in every sort of handwork,
我也以我的靈充滿了他，使他有智慧，有聰明，有知識，能做各樣的工，
to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,
To do all sorts of delicate work in gold and silver and brass;
能想出巧工，用金、銀、銅製造各物，
to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every craft.
In cutting stones for framing, and to do every form of woodwork.
又能刻寶石，可以鑲嵌，能雕刻木頭，能做各樣的工。
Moreover, I have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as his assistant. I have also given skill to all the craftsmen, that they may fashion all that I have commanded you:

And I have made selection of Oholiab with him, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the hearts of all who are wise I have put the knowledge to make whatever I have given you orders to have made;
我分派但支派中、亞希撒抹的兒子亞何利亞伯與他同工。凡心裡有智慧的，我更使他們有智慧，能做我一切所吩咐的，
the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony and the mercy seat upon it, and all the other furnishings of the tent—
The Tent of meeting, and the ark of the law, and the cover which is on it, and all the things for the tent,
就是會幕和法櫃，並其上的施恩座，與會幕中一切的器具，
the table with its utensils, the pure gold lampstand with all its utensils, the altar of incense,
And the table with its vessels, and the holy light-support with all its vessels, and the altar for the burning of spices,
桌子和桌子的器具，精金的燈臺和燈臺的一切器具並香壇，
the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand—
And the altar of burned offerings with all its vessels, and the washing-vessel with its base,
燔祭壇和壇的一切器具，並洗濯盆與盆座，
as well as the woven garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests,
And the robes of needlework, the holy robes for Aaron and for his sons, for their use when acting as priests,
精工做的禮服，和祭司亞倫並他兒子用以供祭司職分的聖衣，
in addition to the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them according to all that I have commanded you.”
And the holy oil, and the perfume of sweet spices for the holy place; they will do whatever I have given you orders to have done.
膏油和為聖所用馨香的香料。他們都要照我一切所吩咐的去做。」
And the LORD said to Moses,
And the Lord said to Moses,
耶和華曉諭摩西說：
“Tell the Israelites, ‘Surely you must keep My Sabbaths, for this will be a sign between Me and you for the generations to come, so that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

Say to the children of Israel that they are to keep my Sabbaths; for the Sabbath day is a sign between me and you through all your generations; so that you may see that I am the Lord who makes you holy.
「你要吩咐以色列人說：『你們務要守我的安息日；因為這是你我之間世世代代的證據，使你們知道我─耶和華是叫你們成為聖的。
Keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Anyone who profanes it must surely be put to death. Whoever does any work on that day must be cut off from among his people.
So you are to keep the Sabbath as a holy day; and anyone not honouring it will certainly be put to death: whoever does any work on that day will be cut off from his people.
所以你們要守安息日，以為聖日。凡干犯這日的，必要把他治死；凡在這日做工的，必從民中剪除。
For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must surely be put to death.
Six days may work be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the Lord; whoever does any work on the Sabbath day is to be put to death.
六日要做工，但第七日是安息聖日，是向耶和華守為聖的。凡在安息日做工的，必要把他治死。』
The Israelites must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come.
And the children of Israel are to keep the Sabbath holy, from generation to generation, by an eternal agreement.
故此，以色列人要世世代代守安息日為永遠的約。
It is a sign between Me and the Israelites forever; for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, but on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.’”
It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever; because in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he took his rest and had pleasure in it.
這是我和以色列人永遠的證據；因為六日之內耶和華造天地，第七日便安息舒暢。」
When the LORD had finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, He gave him the two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.
And when his talk with Moses on Mount Sinai was ended, he gave him the two stones of the law, two stones on which was the writing made by the finger of God.
耶和華在西奈山和摩西說完了話，就把兩塊法版交給他，是神用指頭寫的石版。
